name: soleon-builder
description: The Soleon agent build loop. Everything in soleon-observer, plus: create and update agent drafts, deploy and promote agents, bind channels, and author custom MCP servers and knowledge bases. Includes the deploy-agent skill, which converts a local Claude Code agent identity (.claude/agents/<name>.md) into a validated, deploy-ready POST /agents request via an Allium specification — distill, elicit gaps, and validate fully offline; then deploy the confirmed assets via the Soleon MCP server. And the reverse arrow: pull-agent pulls a Soleon agent into Claude Code as a local subagent that reasons here and runs every tool on the platform, with SOUL.md / config.json / skills / evals materialized as files whose every save lands on your Soleon draft (a conflict stops and asks), and run-local-eval scores it with the platform's own judge prompt.
